title: Fullbright
description: Fullbright mod makes everything bright, pretty and removes glooming darkness of beta 1.7.3.
body:
Fullbright - sets client side light level to maximum, causing to game look less gloomy, more pretty, and without the need to carry stacks of torches. 

Mob spawning or any light related conditions are unaffected, as light level is only forced on client side, server side remains as is, letting mobs to spawn.

Check out my other mods created for b1.7.3:
- [NoHurtCam](https://modrinth.com/mod/nohurtcam-(b1.7.3)), disables hurtcam when player takes damage.
- [Modern Keybind Handling](https://modrinth.com/mod/modern-keybind-handling), makes keys re-register when closing a GUI.
